description:
Billing & dunning (Abrechnung) for Energy Community tenants — EC v2 line
(ADR 0001, AB#4552). Settlements are computed from STREAM DATA
(Basic.Energy/EnergyMeasurement over the raw archive energy-measurements
ec0000000000000000000a01), not from the retired EnergyCommunity/EnergyQuantity
runtime entities.

Installs:
- 10 billing pipelines: create/release/send/unrelease/cancel for billing documents
  and items (single + all variants)
- 1 messaging pipeline: sendMessage (ad-hoc member messaging — AB#4292; sends a
  notification template to an explicit list of recipient email addresses)
- 6 billing/reporting queries (_energy_billing_documents, _energy_billing_items,
  reporting_energy_billing_items, pipeline_energy_billings,
  pipeline_customer_meteringpoints, and the stream-data settlement query
  billing-energy-by-quality ec000000000000000000e001)
- billing-overview MeshBoard (AB#4578): System.UI/Dashboard
  energy-community-accounting + 10 widgets, backed by 6 new
  GroupingAggregationRtQuery board queries (ec00…0e01–0e06) over the EC v2
  Customer / BillingDocument / BillingDocumentLineItem types; the 2
  metering-value widgets bind to the Base stream-data queries (…a22/…a23)
- 5 notification templates with neutral default text:
  - mail-notification-template (quarterly billing email)
  - mail-notification-template-q2 (quarterly billing variant)
  - offene-abrechnung (open invoice reminder)
  - offene-gutschrift (open credit note reminder)
  - prae-zahlungserinnerung (pre-payment-reminder)

Notification templates are seeded with neutral placeholders — customize per tenant
(replace organisation name, IBAN, signature etc.) in Refinery Studio.

Settlement (create-billing-items) sums amount.value per metering point over the
billing period, only for L1/L2 quality intervals, by scoping a persisted
GroupingAggregationSdQuery (billing-energy-by-quality) to the metering point's
EnergyMeasurement anchor rtIds via GetQueryById@1 node fieldFilters
(rtId IN anchors, window_start/window_end within the period). Each
BillingDocumentLineItem persists the summed quantity, the billed TimeRange, the
total intervalCount and the L1/L2/L3/Unknown quality distribution (ADR 0001
decision 3), replacing the removed AssignedBilling -> EnergyQuantity associations.

Prerequisites:
- EnergyCommunity.Base 2.x installed (stream-data archives + rollup ladder,
  ActivateArchive done; provides the raw archive ec0000000000000000000a01)

2.1.2 (AB#4633): fresh-tenant billing fixes surfaced by the EC v2 demo cycle:
(1) the two create-items pipelines (createAllBillingItemsForPeriod,
createBillingItems) now carry a System.Communication/Uses association to the
Base-seeded EnergyCommunityConfiguration (69775cca…) — without it
GetPipelineConfigByWellKnownName@1 fails with HTTP 500
("'EnergyCommunityConfiguration' not found in GlobalConfiguration") on a fresh
install; (2) the two create-documents pipelines
(createAllBillingDocumentsForPeriod, createBillingDocuments) now ship
DeploymentState DEPLOYED (2) to match the create-items pipelines, so the whole
create chain is live after install (previously the documents endpoint 404'd
until a manual DeployDataFlow). The lifecycle pipelines
(release/send/cancel/unrelease/sendMessage) still ship undeployed (0) — deploy
them on demand.

2.1.3 (AB#4554 — de-SBEG-ing): the report / SMTP / BCC / notification-template
values are no longer hardcoded SBEG strings. The report/release/send/message
pipelines now carry a System.Communication/Uses association to the Base-seeded
EnergyCommunityConfiguration (69775cca…) and load it via
GetPipelineConfigByWellKnownName@1, resolving:
  - report URI     ← billingReportName        (MakeHttpRequest@1 valuePath)
  - report prefix  ← billingReportFilePrefix   (MakeHttpRequest@1 valuePath)
  - BCC address    ← notificationEmailContact  (SendEMail@1 bccPath)
Two node fields have no *Path variant in their schema and stay tenant-neutral
literals instead: SendEMail@1.serverConfiguration (= 'billing-smtp'; each tenant
provides an EMailSenderConfiguration with that well-known name — mirrors
EnergyCommunityConfiguration.billingMailServerConfiguration) and
GenerateAndStoreReport@1.reportDefinitionUri/reportFileNamePrefix (the single-
document /releaseBillingDocument pipeline is the config-driven path). Attachment
filename and the notification-template name are neutralized (Abrechnung.pdf /
billing-quarterly-q2). Requires System.Communication 3.31.0 for BankAccountIban,
BankAccountHolder and EmailFooterImage — the first two read as a runtime entity
rather than through GetPipelineConfigByWellKnownName@1, because the typed config
DTO only carries what the controller binary's own CK model declares. Installing
this blueprint against an older System.Communication leaves the two attributes absent,
and ResolveNotificationPlaceholders@1 treats a present entity with a missing value as
empty by data: it substitutes nothing and warns, so offene-abrechnung goes out asking a
member to pay into a blank account. The same happens on a current model whenever nobody
fills the two fields in Settings — the node refuses only when a whole source entity was
never supplied, never on an unset attribute.
Also requires an adapter that registers SendEMail@2 and ResolveNotificationPlaceholders@1.

Post-install:
- Customize notification templates in Refinery Studio
- Provide an EMailSenderConfiguration named 'billing-smtp' (or edit the pipelines)
  and fill EnergyCommunityConfiguration billing fields in Refinery Studio
- The billing create chain (create documents + items) ships DEPLOYED (2); the
  release/send/cancel/unrelease/sendMessage lifecycle pipelines ship undeployed —
  DeployDataFlow those on demand. All are pre-assigned to the Mesh Adapter
  (670…002) via Executes-1, no manual assignment needed.
- Configure the SMTP notification target for outbound mail
